android.desc:
Over 10 million Users's Choice on Google Play! The Most Challenging & Addictive Brain Puzzle game—Take Away, just tailor-made for you!

Are you seeking a fun and mind-boosting puzzle game? Want to take a challenge while relaxing during your free time? Look no further than Take Away - Tap 3D Blocks Out! 

In this 3D blocks puzzle game, you can tap away all the blocks, and it will bring you a fantastic experience and satisfy your imagination.

Enjoy the best popular and creative original games for free at any time and place! It's time to train your brain, challenge yourself, and be a Tap Master!

🔑 HOW TO PLAY Take Away👇
⚈ Tap away the blocks according to the arrows. The cubes can only be tapped out in the direction of the arrow.
⚈ Rotate or zoom in the blocks to find the correct moveable cubes.
⚈ Clear all the blocks in a limited number of moves. So develop your strategy and tap away the 3D blocks in minimum steps!
⚈ If you're trapped in the blocks, don't worry, let the useful bomb props help you tap the cubes!
⚈ When you tap away all the squares, congratulations on completing the level!
⚈ There are tens of thousands of fun levels for you to challenge! Try to tap away blocks and be a tap master in the blocks game world! 

💡FEATURES Of Take Away👇
⚈ 3D graphic visuals and excellent sound effects.
⚈ Relieve your stress and get relaxation in the tap away.
⚈ Train your left-brain thinking and spatial imagination.
⚈ Customize your exquisite themes and various shapes of the blocks.
⚈ Challenge a variety of different difficulty levels to have a brain teaser.
⚈ Interesting block puzzle game for all ages who love to tap away.

In addition, we have added a story mode on top of Take Away's classic gameplay, come and try it!

In the story mode, you can experience a whole new and addictive level! When you tap away the blocks, you can collect items to rebuild the farm and fix the living room. On top of that, there are orchards, camping, and many other interesting scenarios for you to explore! Come to challenge Take Away's first story scene and create your farm! 

What are you hesitating for? Are you ready to navigate this challenging 3D block puzzle? Download and play now! Help the cubes escape and start your amazing journey!

If you like the Take Away puzzle game, please recommend it to your friends to play together and compete to see who can become the tap master!
